analyzer.bound_basis: Each AddNodeIfAbsent with one fixed literal type/key signature can insert at most one node; empty-attribute AddEdge can insert only one directed triple per endpoint pair and edge type. Positive matching and insertion-only effects preserve a finite graph universe. The bound is a coarse O((N+R)^2 E) upper bound on progressing firings, for fixed rules.
